name: Twilight Opal Dunes
description: Desert dunes of crushed opal shifting under twin moons, each grain flashing fire — as they move, they reveal fossilized light: ancient forests, oceans, cities buried in silica.
prompt: Desert dunes of crushed precious opal shifting under twin moons, each grain flashing play-of-color fire — red, green, blue, gold — dune movement revealing fossilized light layers: ancient forests, prehistoric oceans, lost cities preserved in silica, iridescent sands, dramatic moonlight, 8k, geological fantasy
caption: The desert remembers everything. It just waits for moonlight to speak. 🌙💎
